name: Cuba
hook: Castro, Batista, the Bay of Pigs and Guantanamo Bay: Cuba's clues are a Cold War history quiz.

facts.label: Fidel Castro
facts.statement: Fidel Castro launched the 26th of July Movement with his failed 1953 attack on a Santiago de Cuba barracks, then built a guerrilla base in the Sierra Maestra.

facts.label: Fulgencio Batista
facts.statement: Fulgencio Batista ruled Cuba from 1952 to 1959; he fled to the Dominican Republic on New Year's Day 1959, and his palace is now Havana's Museum of the Revolution.

facts.label: the Bay of Pigs
facts.statement: The Bay of Pigs is Cuba's Bahia de Cochinos, site of the 1961 invasion; Cuba's Order of Playa Giron commemorates the victory.

facts.label: Guantanamo Bay
facts.statement: Guantanamo Bay, near the Windward Passage, holds a U.S. naval base; Marines first landed there during the Spanish-American War.

facts.label: Ernest Hemingway
facts.statement: Ernest Hemingway lived and wrote in Cuba; in 1961 JFK helped his widow get permission to retrieve his papers there.

facts.label: the Spanish-American War
facts.statement: The Spanish-American War's first land battle was at Las Guasimas, Cuba, on June 24, 1898; its last Western Hemisphere action was in Puerto Rico.

facts.label: rum
facts.statement: Rum is the base of a Cuba libre; Don Facundo Bacardi built a Cuban distillery to make it in 1862.
